metadata.notes: Per-seat RB share is only populated where Wikipedia (or another verifiable public source) has a parenthetical '(RB X%)' annotation or a tabulated Restore Britain / Great Yarmouth First candidate result. Every other PCON falls back to the national overlay. Counties where RB ran a candidate slate on 7 May 2026 are listed under `county_council_results` for reference; they're not yet wired into the per-PCON projection because of the May-26 local→Westminster swing-back gap.

constituency_overrides_explain: Populate `constituency_shares` keyed by PCON24CD (e.g. E14001210) with values { share: 0.0..0.2, source: '...', wikipedia: '...' }. The UI prefers this map; missing entries fall back to `national_fallback_share`.
